stem: The model of the nuclear atom was first proposed by Ernest Rutherford. He developed this model on the basis of results obtained from an experiment using gold metal foil.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: State the type of bonding in gold.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.stem: A sample of gold found in the earth consists of only one isotope.
parts.text: Explain what is meant by the term *isotopes*.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text:
A different sample of gold contains more than one isotope.

Suggest why this different sample of gold has the same **chemical** properties as the sample found in the earth.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.stem:
*Tumbaga* is an alloy of copper and gold. A sample of tumbaga was analysed. The mass spectrum of the sample is shown.

{{figure:visual_auto_01.png}}
parts.text: Calculate the percentage abundance of gold, $x$, in the sample of tumbaga.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text: Calculate the relative atomic mass, $A_{\text{r}}$, of the copper present in this sample. Give your answer to **two** decimal places.
